title: Cohort-based region ranker with predictive jumpback and fallback variant matrix
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Implement a cohort-aware region ranking service that fuses p50/p95 latency telemetry with active synthetic probes and a network health score. The ranker should: 1) compute per-cohort pop rankings instead of a single global score, 2) apply a jitter/jitter-penalty to avoid flip-flopping during small deltas, 3) provide a predictive jumpback mechanism to reduce cooldown for regions that show improving trends, and 4) wire a fallback variant matrix that maps model variants (quantized / half-precision / smaller models) to region tiers for graceful degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Per-cohort rank calculation exposed via /ranker/v1?cohort=<id> returning ordered pop list with p50/p95 and health_score
Jitter penalty reduces flapping: a region must cross combined score threshold by configured margin for 3 consecutive windows before move
Predictive jumpback shortens cooldown by up to 50% when 5-window trend shows >=10% improvement in p95 and packet loss <0.2%
Fallback matrix applied at routing time: when primary region fails soft-threshold, request is routed to next-ranked region with mapped compatible model variant
E2E test demonstrating failover sequence from primary (gpu-q4) -> fallback (cpu-q4) -> second fallback (gpu-q2) with preserved SLO degradation profile
Dashboard updated with cohort-level rank history and decision rationale (p50, p95, health components, jitter margin used)
steps: Design: finalize scoring formula that blends p50, p95, probe-latency and packet-loss into a 0..100 health score (owner: Tomás)
Proto: implement in ranker service with feature flag behind 'cohort_ranker' (owner: Tomás)
Instrumentation: add synthetic probe pipeline and cohort tagging in telemetry ingestion (owner: telemetry team)
Safety: implement jitter-penalty + consecutive-window gating and predictive-jumpback logic (owner: SRE)
Fallback mapping: author variant compatibility table and integrate into routing policy (owner: runtime team)
Testing: unit, integration, and chaos test scenarios including regional packet loss and warm-up ramps (owner: QA)
Rollout: canary to 5% traffic, monitor regression alerts and rollback criteria (owner: product ops)
Postmortem: collect metrics after 2 weeks and refine thresholds
decision_log: 2025-01-17: Chose blended health score (0.5*p95_norm + 0.3*p50_norm + 0.15*probe_norm + 0.05*packet_loss_penalty) to emphasize tail latency without ignoring median
2025-01-20: Adopted 3-window consecutive threshold to reduce oscillations after experiments in staging
2025-01-28: Enabled predictive jumpback with conservative bounds (+50% cooldown reduction max) to avoid premature flips
2025-02-02: Mapped fallback variant order: same-precision smaller-model -> quantized-gpu -> quantized-cpu. This preserves latency when possible and reduces cost

risk_mitigation: Feature flag gated by 'cohort_ranker' with ability to opt cohorts into legacy global ranker
Rate-limited synthetic probes and aggregated sampling to avoid telemetry amplification
Fallback variant mapping validated by compatibility matrix and pre-deployment smoke tests
Circuit breaker to stop jumpback triggers if error-rate exceeds 0.5% in a 5-minute window
notes: This work aims to reduce customer-visible tail latency regressions during partial regional degradation while minimizing unnecessary cross-pop traffic. Emphasis on explainability: every routing decision must include the last 5 windows of metrics used to compute score.
qa_checklist: Unit tests for scoring math and boundary conditions
Integration test with synthetic probe harness
Canary run logs saved and compared against baseline for 'mobile-eu' and 'web-na' cohorts
Load test with 20% simultaneous cohort variance to validate jitter penalty effectiveness
Manual review of fallback flows with security team for data path verification
implementation_notes: Score normalization: use rolling 99th-percentile baseline per region to normalize p95 and p50
Smoothing: exponential moving average (alpha=0.25) applied to p95 to reduce noise
Config: expose jitter_margin, consecutive_windows, jumpback_factor as runtime flags per cohort
Telemetry cost: synthetic probes add ~3% extra metrics ingress for cohorts opted-in; billback handled by telemetry budget
